title: Spectral extremal graphs for even factors
summary: An even factor of a graph $G$ is a spanning subgraph in which every vertex has positive even degree. It is known that the minimum degree $δ(G)\ge 2$ is a trivial necessary condition for $G$ to have an even factor. Recent spectral results for the existence of even factors used the certain complete-join graphs as exceptional extremal graphs. However, these graphs already contain $2$-factors and therefore are not genuine obstructions.
